name: SVC Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, SVC Industries Ltd is in the business of Mega Food Park, Integrated Logistic Park and Warehousing facilities
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company used to manufacture Purified Terephthalic Acid (PTA) but discontinued its production in FY18. Company then entered new ventures viz. Mega Food Park, Integrated Logistic Park and Warehousing facilities. Company and its co-investor received approval from Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India to set up a processing plant for Mega Food Park. But due to delay  on part of State Government Authorities and Mathura Vrindavan Development Authority (MVDA) in granting requisite permission for  Mega Food Park. Ministry of Food Processing withdrew its permission for setting up of  Mega Food Park on company's land

pros: Stock is trading at 0.20 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.92% over last 3 years.
